title: The owner lifts the bar on starting Editor, Sites, Etsy and App Platform from a scan or a docs pass
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20 (ADR-1814). The session index carried one line barring a scan or docs pass from starting Editor / Sites / Etsy / App Platform. The owner tapped Relax it. AGENTS.md now says product work still outranks craft on a collision, and a scan or docs pass may start those rows. ADR-1403's own ruling table never held the bar, so it is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('AGENTS.md','utf8');if(/do not start Editor \\/ Sites \\/ Etsy \\/ App Platform from a scan or a docs pass\\.\\s*$/m.test(s)||!s.includes('ADR-1814')){console.error('OWN-097: AGENTS.md still carries the bar or does not cite ADR-1814');process.exit(1)}"
